import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Source file path
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_46/test_0.csv"
    # Target output path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_46/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load Source 0 data
    df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)

    # Inspect columns of Source 0:
    # ['Text Date', 'Value Date', 'Zip Code', 'Water Use', 'Power Use']

    # Transformation plan:
    # - Target schema: ['Date': string, 'Water Use': float, 'Power Use': integer]
    # - From Source 0, use 'Text Date' as 'Date'
    # - Aggregate by 'Text Date' to combine multiple Zip Codes (if any)
    # - Sum Water Use (float), sum Power Use (int)
    # - Convert Power Use to int after aggregation

    # Group by 'Text Date' and aggregate Water Use and Power Use by sum
    grouped = df0.groupby('Text Date', as_index=False).agg({
        'Water Use': 'sum',
        'Power Use': 'sum'
    })

    # Rename 'Text Date' to 'Date'
    grouped.rename(columns={'Text Date': 'Date'}, inplace=True)

    # Ensure data types
    grouped['Water Use'] = grouped['Water Use'].astype(float)
    grouped['Power Use'] = grouped['Power Use'].astype(int)
    grouped['Date'] = grouped['Date'].astype(str)

    # The result is the target table Target1_46
    Target1_46 = grouped[['Date', 'Water Use', 'Power Use']]

    # Save to CSV
    Target1_46.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
